concerns.text: T014 (run_snippy.sh) is marked as unchecked/missing. FR-002 explicitly mandates 'preprocess sequences to call SNPs using Snippy'. Without this task, the core data ingestion requirement is unimplemented, violating the spec's functional requirement.

T017 and T018 (handling edge cases for <50 isolates) are unchecked. The spec's 'Edge Cases' section mandates specific system behaviors (exclude class with warning, abort with E004 if all fail). These acceptance criteria are missing from the task list.

T024 (stratified cross-validation) is unchecked. FR-004 requires '5-fold cross-validation'. T023c mentions 'Phylogenetically-Blocked CV' but T024 is the specific task for the stratified CV logic required by FR-004. Its absence leaves the cross-validation requirement unverified.

T026 (export top genomic features) is unchecked. US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3 requires 'top 10 genomic features... are ranked and exported to a summary table'. This deliverable is missing from the task list.

T031 (writing p-value to permutation_results.json) is unchecked. SC-002 requires measuring significance against a null distribution with p<0.05. Without the task to write and flag this result, the success criterion cannot be verified.
T033 (reporting false-positive/negative rates) is unchecked. SC-003 requires reporting the variation in these rates across the threshold sweep. This specific output is missing from the task list.

T035 (main_reproducible.py) is unchecked. Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and US-3 Acceptance Scenario 3 require a script to 're-execute the full pipeline... and verify checksums'. This critical reproducibility task is missing.

T003 (linting), T007 (data dirs), and T008 (test dirs) are unchecked. Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and III (Data Hygiene) require a verifiable project structure and pinned dependencies. Missing these tasks violates the constitutional requirements for project hygiene.
